name: InterpolatingHelixEngine
description:
Engine applying spiral motion, finding current angular velocity by linearly interpolating in times and velocities and translation by using slope parameter. 

 The interpolation assumes the margin value before the first time point and last value after the last time point. If wrap is specified, time...

attributes.name: angleTurned
attributes.description: How much have we turned so far. |yupdate| [rad]

attributes.name: angularVelocities
attributes.description: List of angular velocities; manadatorily of same length as times. [rad/s]

attributes.name: rotateAroundZero
attributes.description: If True, bodies will not rotate around their centroids, but rather around ``zeroPoint``.

attributes.name: rotationAxis
attributes.description: Axis of rotation (direction); will be normalized automatically.

attributes.name: slope
attributes.description: Axial translation per radian turn (can be negative) [m/rad]

attributes.name: times
attributes.description: List of time points at which velocities are given; must be increasing [s]

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wrap t if t>times_n, i.e. t_wrapped=t-N*(times_n-times_0)

attributes.name: zeroPoint
attributes.description: Point around which bodies will rotate if ``rotateAroundZero`` is True
